title: Set up the local databases with dev-setup.sh
caption: deploy/scripts/dev-setup.sh and docs/mvp/local-development.md §2. Passwords are development only (.env.example).

steps.title: Install PostgreSQL 16 and Redis 7.4
steps.body: Ubuntu 24.04 (apt) or macOS (Homebrew). The script starts them if installed but stopped.

steps.title: Run the setup
steps.body: `bash deploy/scripts/dev-setup.sh` from anywhere in the repository (it calls sudo for the postgres superuser on Linux).
steps.expect: A summary "Velexis local services": status `ok` over TCP for every login of `.env.example` (`velexis_migrator`/`dev_migrator`, `velexis_provisioner`/`dev_provisioner`, `velexis_platform_app`/`dev_platform`, `velexis_ota_app`/`dev_ota`, `velexis_test_admin`/`dev_test_admin`; development only), the row `password required` `ok` for Redis (`dev_redis`), then "Next steps".

steps.title: Run it again
steps.expect: Same summary, Redis now `password already set (unchanged)`; nothing changed. A failed login shows `FAILED` and the run ends `ERROR: a check failed (see FAILED above)`, exit 1.

steps.title: Next steps it prints
steps.body: `cp .env.example .env.local` (only while `.env.local` is missing), `pnpm dev:keys`, `pnpm build && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed:reference`.

steps.title: Guard
steps.body: On a machine with `/etc/velexis` the script refuses to run.
steps.expect: `ERROR: /etc/velexis exists, so this looks like a Velexis production host. …` and exit 1, before PostgreSQL or Redis is touched.
